description: Finds a FrontMCP API by name in the Reference pages: a decorator (`@Tool`), function or method (`createFetchHandler`, `this.elicit`), option (`inputSchema`, `throttle`), error code (`TOOL_NOT_FOUND`), CLI command or flag (`--target`). Returns the matching entries, most relevant first, each with what the docs say, its page and anchor. Read more with get_page.

symbol.description: The name, with or without `@`, `this.` or parentheses.

version.description: A documented FrontMCP version, like "1.9.4", or a minor, like "1.9", for its newest patch. Pass the version resolve_version found for the project. Defaults to the version this endpoint serves.

name: lookup_api
title: Look up an API
